description: Show a product MODEL as one eBay multi-variation listing: state (none, draft, live), marketplaceId, listingId and listingUrl, the stable groupKey, and every article of the model with its sku, colour, size, channelState on eBay and inclusion — included, not_active, not_on_channel (put it on the channel with set_channel_membership) or single_listing (it has its own eBay draft or listing, which must be deleted or ended first). Also says whether eBay is connected and whether the owner armed listing creation. Reads the CRM only. Use inspect_ebay_variation_listing for eBay's own checks before saving.

model.description: The product model: its code — the productGroupId get_product and search_products return for every article of it — or its id. Its active articles on the eBay channel become the listing's variations.

name: get_ebay_variation_listing
title: Get a model's eBay variation listing
